# GNSS daily positions, Nevada Geodetic Laboratory (IGS20)

`ngl_gnss` · adapter 1.0.0 · makes `gnss_daily` tokens

| | |
|---|---|
| Provider | Nevada Geodetic Laboratory, University of Nevada, Reno |
| Home | https://geodesy.unr.edu/ |
| Licence | `LicenseRef-NGL-as-is` |

## Terms

NGL publishes no licence. Its disclaimer says the data are supplied as-is with no warranty, and its acknowledgements page asks every user to cite Blewitt et al. (2018) and, where one exists, the original data citation of each station. Craton keeps the raw files in its local cache and redistributes none of them.

## Cite

- Blewitt, G., W. C. Hammond, and C. Kreemer (2018). Harnessing the GPS data explosion for interdisciplinary science. Eos, 99. https://doi.org/10.1029/2018EO104623
- Most central-Italian stations belong to INGV's RING network and other Italian networks; their own data citations are listed on each NGL station page.

## Access

Station list `https://geodesy.unr.edu/NGLStationPages/DataHoldings.txt`, then one `tenv3` file per station from `https://geodesy.unr.edu/gps_timeseries/IGS20/tenv3/IGS20/{station}.tenv3`. At most one request per second; each file is downloaded once and cached by hash, and only `craton data fetch --refresh` asks again.

## From the source to the token

| Token slot | Comes from |
|---|---|
| `kind` | `observation` |
| `lat, lon` | the day's latitude and longitude (longitude wrapped, D-013) |
| `depth_km` | minus the day's ellipsoidal height / 1000 |
| `time` | noon UTC of the solution's day |
| `value` | east = _e0 + __east, north = ____n0 + _north, up = u0 + ____up (metres) |
| `uncertainty` | sig_e, sig_n, sig_u (reported) |
| `qualifiers` | station ← site, reference_frame = IGS20 |
| `provenance.record` | `<site>.tenv3 <YYMMMDD> reflon=<reflon>` |
| `provenance.content_hash` | sha256 of the station's raw tenv3 file |

## Uncertainty

NGL's formal 1σ per component (`uncertainty_basis: reported`). Formal GNSS errors are known to be optimistic; correlated noise is not in them.

## Known issues

- East is measured from a reference meridian (`reflon`, written in the record), north from the equator and up from the ellipsoid. Compare a station with itself over time; positions of two stations are not on one local grid.
- Daily solutions have the solid-Earth tide modelled out already. The tide tokens (`iers_tides`) are a separate forcing, not a correction to apply again.
- Antenna changes and earthquakes put steps in the series; NGL lists them on each station page. Nothing here removes them: the 2016 steps are signal.
- Some stations have long gaps; the health report counts gaps over 30 days.
- NGL reprocesses its archive from time to time; a refresh brings new bytes, a new hash and new tokens.
